data.name: Meta3Prop_source-of_Desc
data.value: Indicates a unique aspect of an adapted source resource that has been retained in the given Rendition of the EPUB Publication. This specification defines the pagination value to indicate that the referenced source element is the source of the pagebreak properties defined in the content. This value should be set whenever pagination is included and the print source is known. Valid values: pagination.

data.name: Meta3Prop_custom-property_Desc
data.value: An empty metadata property or attribute you can modify.

data.name: Meta3XProp_dir_Desc
data.value: Optional text direction attribute for this metadata item.

data.name: Meta3XProp_title-type_Desc
data.value: Indicates the kind or type of the title

data.name: Meta3XProp_collection-type_Desc
data.value: Property used with belongs-to-collection. Indicates the form or nature of a collection.

data.name: Meta3XProp_source-of_Desc
data.value: Indicates a unique aspect of an adapted source resource that has been retained in the given Rendition of the EPUB Publication.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:creator-aut_Desc
data.value: Represents a primary author of the book or publication

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:title_Desc
data.value: The main title of the epub publication. Only one title may exist.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:creator_Desc
data.value: Represents the name of a person, organization, etc. responsible for the creation of the content of an EPUB Publication. The attributes opf:role, opf:scheme and opf:file-as can be attached to the element to indicate the function the creator played in the creation of the content.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:contributor_Desc
data.value: Represents the name of a person, organization, etc. that played a secondary role in the creation of the content of an EPUB Publication'

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:subject_Desc
data.value: An arbitrary phrase or keyword describing the subject in question. Use multiple 'subject' elements if needed.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:publisher_Desc
data.value: An entity responsible for making the publication available.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:date_Desc
data.value: A date associated with this epub, typically refined by event type information

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:type_Desc
data.value: The nature or genre of the content of the resource.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:format_Desc
data.value: The media type or dimensions of the publication. Best practice is to use a value from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. MIME media types).

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:source_Desc
data.value: A reference to a resource from which the present publication is derived.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:language_Desc
data.value: A language used in the publication. Choose a RFC5646 value.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:relation_Desc
data.value: A reference to a related resource. The recommended best practice is to identify the referenced resource by means of a string or number conforming to a formal identification system.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:coverage_Desc
data.value: The extent or scope of the content of the publication's content.

data.name: Meta2Elem_dc:rights_Desc
data.value: Information about rights held in and over the publication. Rights information often encompasses Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), Copyright, and various Property Rights. If the Rights element is absent, no assumptions may be made about any rights held in or over the publication.

data.name: Meta2Elem_calibre:series_index_Desc
data.value: Index of this book in the series (from calibre)

data.name: Meta2Elem_calibre:title_sort_Desc
data.value: Version of ebook title to use for sorting (from calibre)

data.name: Meta2Elem_custom-element_Desc
data.value: An empty element for you to modify

data.name: Meta2Prop_id_Desc
data.value: Optional, typically short, unique identifier string used as an attribute in the Package (opf) document.

data.name: Meta2Prop_xml:lang_Desc
data.value: Optional, language specifying attribute. Uses same codes as dc:language. Not for use with dc:language, dc:date, or dc:identifier metadata elements.

data.name: Meta2Prop_opf:file-as_Desc
data.value: Provides the normalized form of the associated property for sorting. Typically used with author, creator, and contributor names.

data.name: Meta2Prop_opf:role_Desc
data.value: Describes the nature of work performed by a creator or contributor (e.g., that the person is the author or editor of a work). Typically used with the marc:relators scheme for a controlled vocabulary.

data.name: Meta2Prop_opf:scheme_Desc
data.value: This attribute is typically added to dc:identifier to indicate the type of identifier being used: DOI, ISBN, ISSN, UUID, or AMAZON.

data.name: Meta2Prop_opf:scheme-custom_Desc
data.value: This attribute is typically added to dc:identifier to indicate that a custom identifier scheme is being used.

data.name: Meta2Prop_opf:event_Desc
data.value: This attribute is typically added to dc:date elements to specify the date type: publication, creation, or modification.

data.name: Meta2Prop_custom-property_Desc
data.value: An empty metadata attribute you can modify.

data.name: Meta2XProp_ISBN_Desc
data.value: Identifier Scheme: International Standard Book Number

data.name: Meta2XProp_ISSN_Desc
data.value: Identifier Scheme: International Standard Serial Number

data.name: Lang_zza_Name
data.value: Dimili, Dimli, Zaza, Zazaki, Kirdki, Kirmanjki

data.name: Marc_abr_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a resource by shortening or condensing the original work but leaving the nature and content of the original work substantially unchanged. For substantial modifications that result in the creation of a new work, see Author.

data.name: Marc_act_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who principally exhibits acting skills in a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_adp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who 1) reworks a musical composition, usually for a different medium, or 2) rewrites novels or stories for motion pictures or other audiovisual medium.

data.name: Marc_anl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that reviews, examines and interprets data or information in a specific area.

data.name: Marc_anm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who draws the two-dimensional figures, manipulates the three dimensional objects and/or also programs the computer to move objects and images for the purpose of animated film processing. Animation cameras, stands, celluloid screens, transparencies and inks are some of the tools of the animator.

data.name: Marc_ann_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who writes manuscript annotations on a printed item.

data.name: Marc_apl_Desc
data.value: A person or organization who appeals a lower court's decision.

data.name: Marc_ape_Desc
data.value: A person or organization against whom an appeal is taken.

data.name: Marc_app_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the submission of an application or who is named as eligible for the results of the processing of the application (e.g., bestowing of rights, reward, title, position).

data.name: Marc_arc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who designs structures or oversees their construction.

data.name: Marc_arr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who transcribes a musical composition, usually for a different medium from that of the original; in an arrangement the musical substance remains essentially unchanged.

data.name: Marc_acp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person (e.g., a painter or sculptor) who makes copies of works of visual art.

data.name: Marc_adi_Desc
data.value: A person contributing to a motion picture or television production by overseeing the artists and craftspeople who build the sets.

data.name: Marc_art_Desc
data.value: Use for a person (e.g., a painter) or organization who conceives, and perhaps also implements, an original graphic design or work of art, if specific codes (e.g., [egr], [etr]) are not desired. For book illustrators, prefer Illustrator [ill].

data.name: Marc_ard_Desc
data.value: Use for a person responsible for controlling the development of the artistic style of an entire production, including the choice of works to be presented and selection of senior production staff.

data.name: Marc_asg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization to whom a license for printing or publishing has been transferred.

data.name: Marc_asn_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization associated with or found in an item or collection, which cannot be determined to be that of a Former owner [fmo] or other designated relator indicative of provenance.

data.name: Marc_att_Desc
data.value: Use for an author, artist, etc., relating him/her to a work for which there is or once was substantial authority for designating that person as author, creator, etc. of the work.

data.name: Marc_auc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization in charge of the estimation and public auctioning of goods, particularly books, artistic works, etc.

data.name: Marc_aut_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization chiefly responsible for the intellectual or artistic content of a work, usually printed text. This term may also be used when more than one person or body bears such responsibility.

data.name: Marc_aqt_Name
data.value: Author in quotations or text extracts

data.name: Marc_aqt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization whose work is largely quoted or extracted in works to which he or she did not contribute directly. Such quotations are found particularly in exhibition catalogs, collections of photographs, etc.

data.name: Marc_aft_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for an afterword, postface, colophon, etc. but who is not the chief author of a work.

data.name: Marc_aud_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the dialog or spoken commentary for a screenplay or sound recording.

data.name: Marc_aui_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for an introduction, preface, foreword, or other critical introductory matter, but who is not the chief author.

data.name: Marc_aus_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for a motion picture screenplay, dialog, spoken commentary, etc.

data.name: Marc_ato_Desc
data.value: A person whose manuscript signature appears on an item.

data.name: Marc_ant_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for a work upon which the work represented by the catalog record is based. This may be appropriate for adaptations, sequels, continuations, indexes, etc.

data.name: Marc_bnd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the binding of printed or manuscript materials.

data.name: Marc_bdd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the binding design of a book, including the type of binding, the type of materials used, and any decorative aspects of the binding.

data.name: Marc_blw_Desc
data.value: A person or organization responsible for writing a commendation or testimonial for a work, which appears on or within the publication itself, frequently on the back or dust jacket of print publications or on advertising material for all media.

data.name: Marc_bkd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the entire graphic design of a book, including arrangement of type and illustration, choice of materials, and process used.

data.name: Marc_bkp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the production of books and other print media, if specific codes (e.g., [bkd], [egr], [tyd], [prt]) are not desired.

data.name: Marc_bjd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the design of flexible covers designed for or published with a book, including the type of materials used, and any decorative aspects of the bookjacket.

data.name: Marc_bpd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the design of a book owner's identification label that is most commonly pasted to the inside front cover of a book.

data.name: Marc_bsl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who makes books and other bibliographic materials available for purchase. Interest in the materials is primarily lucrative.

data.name: Marc_brl_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization involved in manufacturing a resource by embossing Braille cells using a stylus, special embossing printer, or other device.

data.name: Marc_brd_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization involved in broadcasting a resource to an audience via radio, television, webcast, etc.

data.name: Marc_cll_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who writes in an artistic hand, usually as a copyist and or engrosser.

data.name: Marc_ctg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the creation of maps and other cartographic materials.

data.name: Marc_cas_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization involved in manufacturing a resource by pouring a liquid or molten substance into a mold and leaving it to solidify to take the shape of the mold.

data.name: Marc_cns_Desc
data.value: Use for a censor, bowdlerizer, expurgator, etc., official or private.

data.name: Marc_chr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who composes or arranges dances or other movements (e.g., "master of swords") for a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_cng_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is in charge of the images captured for a motion picture film. The cinematographer works under the supervision of a director, and may also be referred to as director of photography. Do not confuse with videographer.

data.name: Marc_cli_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization for whom another person or organization is acting.

data.name: Marc_cor_Desc
data.value: A curator who lists or inventories the items in an aggregate work such as a collection of items or works.

data.name: Marc_col_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who has brought together material from various sources that has been arranged, described, and cataloged as a collection. A collector is neither the creator of the material nor a person to whom manuscripts in the collection may have been addressed.

data.name: Marc_clt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the production of photographic prints from film or other colloid that has ink-receptive and ink-repellent surfaces.

data.name: Marc_clr_Desc
data.value: A person or organization responsible for applying color to drawings, prints, photographs, maps, moving images, etc.

data.name: Marc_cmm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who provides interpretation, analysis, or a discussion of the subject matter on a recording, motion picture, or other audiovisual medium.

data.name: Marc_cwt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the commentary or explanatory notes about a text. For the writer of manuscript annotations in a printed book, use Annotator [ann].

data.name: Marc_com_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who produces a work or publication by selecting and putting together material from the works of various persons or bodies.

data.name: Marc_cpl_Desc
data.value: Use for the party who applies to the courts for redress, usually in an equity proceeding.

data.name: Marc_cpt_Desc
data.value: Use for a complainant who takes an appeal from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in an equity proceeding.

data.name: Marc_cpe_Desc
data.value: Use for a complainant against whom an appeal is taken from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in an equity proceeding.

data.name: Marc_cmp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who creates a musical work, usually a piece of music in manuscript or printed form.

data.name: Marc_cmt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the creation of metal slug, or molds made of other materials, used to produce the text and images in printed matter.

data.name: Marc_ccp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the original idea on which a work is based, this includes the scientific author of an audio-visual item and the conceptor of an advertisement.

data.name: Marc_cnd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who directs a performing group (orchestra, chorus, opera, etc.) in a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_con_Desc
data.value: A person or organization responsible for documenting, preserving, or treating printed or manuscript material, works of art, artifacts, or other media.

data.name: Marc_csl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization relevant to a resource, who is called upon for professional advice or services in a specialized field of knowledge or training.

data.name: Marc_csp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization relevant to a resource, who is engaged specifically to provide an intellectual overview of a strategic or operational task and by analysis, specification, or instruction, to create or propose a cost-effective course of action or solution.

data.name: Marc_cos_Desc
data.value: Use for the party who opposes, resists, or disputes, in a court of law, a claim, decision, result, etc.

data.name: Marc_cot_Desc
data.value: Use for a contestant who takes an appeal from one court of law or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_coe_Desc
data.value: Use for a contestant against whom an appeal is taken from one court of law or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_cts_Desc
data.value: Use for the party defending a claim, decision, result, etc. being opposed, resisted, or disputed in a court of law.

data.name: Marc_ctt_Desc
data.value: Use for a contestee who takes an appeal from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_cte_Desc
data.value: Use for a contestee against whom an appeal is taken from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_ctr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization relevant to a resource, who enters into a contract with another person or organization to perform a specific task.

data.name: Marc_ctb_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization one whose work has been contributed to a larger work, such as an anthology, serial publication, or other compilation of individual works. Do not use if the sole function in relation to a work is as author, editor, compiler or translator.

data.name: Marc_cpc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization listed as a copyright owner at the time of registration. Copyright can be granted or later transferred to another person or organization, at which time the claimant becomes the copyright holder.

data.name: Marc_cph_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization to whom copy and legal rights have been granted or transferred for the intellectual content of a work. The copyright holder, although not necessarily the creator of the work, usually has the exclusive right to benefit financially from the sale and use of the work to which the associated copyright protection applies.

data.name: Marc_crr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is a corrector of manuscripts, such as the scriptorium official who corrected the work of a scribe. For printed matter, use Proofreader.

data.name: Marc_crp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who was either the writer or recipient of a letter or other communication.

data.name: Marc_cst_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who designs or makes costumes, fixes hair, etc., for a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_cou_Desc
data.value: A court governed by court rules, regardless of their official nature (e.g., laws, administrative regulations.)

data.name: Marc_crt_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a resource by preparing a court's opinions for publication.

data.name: Marc_cov_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the graphic design of a book cover, album cover, slipcase, box, container, etc. For a person or organization responsible for the graphic design of an entire book, use Book designer; for book jackets, use Bookjacket designer.

data.name: Marc_cre_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the intellectual or artistic content of a work.

data.name: Marc_cur_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for conceiving and organizing an exhibition.

data.name: Marc_dnc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who principally exhibits dancing skills in a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_dtc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that submits data for inclusion in a database or other collection of data.

data.name: Marc_dtm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for managing databases or other data sources.

data.name: Marc_dte_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization to whom a book, manuscript, etc., is dedicated (not the recipient of a gift).

data.name: Marc_dto_Desc
data.value: Use for the author of a dedication, which may be a formal statement or in epistolary or verse form.

data.name: Marc_dfd_Desc
data.value: Use for the party defending or denying allegations made in a suit and against whom relief or recovery is sought in the courts, usually in a legal action.

data.name: Marc_dft_Desc
data.value: Use for a defendant who takes an appeal from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in a legal action.

data.name: Marc_dfe_Desc
data.value: Use for a defendant against whom an appeal is taken from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in a legal action.

data.name: Marc_dgg_Desc
data.value: Use for the organization granting a degree for which the thesis or dissertation described was presented.

data.name: Marc_dln_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization executing technical drawings from others' designs.

data.name: Marc_dpc_Desc
data.value: Use for an entity depicted or portrayed in a work, particularly in a work of art.

data.name: Marc_dpt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization placing material in the physical custody of a library or repository without transferring the legal title.

data.name: Marc_dsr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the design if more specific codes (e.g., [bkd], [tyd]) are not desired.

data.name: Marc_drt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is responsible for the general management of a work or who supervises the production of a performance for stage, screen, or sound recording.

data.name: Marc_dis_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who presents a thesis for a university or higher-level educational degree.

data.name: Marc_dbp_Desc
data.value: A place from which a resource, e.g., a serial, is distributed.

data.name: Marc_dst_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that has exclusive or shared marketing rights for an item.

data.name: Marc_dnr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is the donor of a book, manuscript, etc., to its present owner. Donors to previous owners are designated as Former owner [fmo] or Inscriber [ins].

data.name: Marc_drm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who prepares artistic or technical drawings.

data.name: Marc_dub_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization to which authorship has been dubiously or incorrectly ascribed.

data.name: Marc_edt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who prepares for publication a work not primarily his/her own, such as by elucidating text, adding introductory or other critical matter, or technically directing an editorial staff.

data.name: Marc_edc_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a collective or aggregate work by selecting and putting together works, or parts of works, by one or more creators. For compilations of data, information, etc., that result in new works, see compiler.

data.name: Marc_edm_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization responsible for assembling, arranging, and trimming film, video, or other moving image formats, including both visual and audio aspects.

data.name: Marc_elg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person responsible for setting up a lighting rig and focusing the lights for a production, and running the lighting at a performance.

data.name: Marc_elt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who creates a duplicate printing surface by pressure molding and electrodepositing of metal that is then backed up with lead for printing.

data.name: Marc_eng_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that is responsible for technical planning and design, particularly with construction.

data.name: Marc_egr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who cuts letters, figures, etc. on a surface, such as a wooden or metal plate, for printing.

data.name: Marc_etr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who produces text or images for printing by subjecting metal, glass, or some other surface to acid or the corrosive action of some other substance.

data.name: Marc_evp_Desc
data.value: A place where an event such as a conference or a concert took place.

data.name: Marc_exp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization in charge of the description and appraisal of the value of goods, particularly rare items, works of art, etc.

data.name: Marc_fac_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that executed the facsimile.

data.name: Marc_fld_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that manages or supervises the work done to collect raw data or do research in an actual setting or environment (typically applies to the natural and social sciences).

data.name: Marc_fmd_Desc
data.value: A director responsible for the general management and supervision of a filmed performance.

data.name: Marc_fds_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization involved in distributing a moving image resource to theatres or other distribution channels.

data.name: Marc_flm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is an editor of a motion picture film. This term is used regardless of the medium upon which the motion picture is produced or manufactured (e.g., acetate film, video tape).

data.name: Marc_fmp_Desc
data.value: A producer responsible for most of the business aspects of a film.

data.name: Marc_fmk_Desc
data.value: A person, family or organization responsible for creating an independent or personal film. A filmmaker is individually responsible for the conception and execution of all aspects of the film.

data.name: Marc_fpy_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is identified as the only party or the party of the first part. In the case of transfer of right, this is the assignor, transferor, licensor, grantor, etc. Multiple parties can be named jointly as the first party.

data.name: Marc_frg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who makes or imitates something of value or importance, especially with the intent to defraud.

data.name: Marc_fmo_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who owned an item at any time in the past. Includes those to whom the material was once presented. A person or organization giving the item to the present owner is designated as Donor [dnr].

data.name: Marc_fnd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that furnished financial support for the production of the work.

data.name: Marc_gis_Desc
data.value: Use for a person responsible for geographic information system (GIS) development and integration with global positioning system data.

data.name: Marc_hnr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization in memory or honor of whom a book, manuscript, etc. is donated.

data.name: Marc_hst_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who is invited or regularly leads a program (often broadcast) that includes other guests, performers, etc. (e.g., talk show host).

data.name: Marc_his_Desc
data.value: An organization hosting the event, exhibit, conference, etc., which gave rise to a resource, but having little or no responsibility for the content of the resource.

data.name: Marc_ilu_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the decoration of a work (especially manuscript material) with precious metals or color, usually with elaborate designs and motifs.

data.name: Marc_ill_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who conceives, and perhaps also implements, a design or illustration, usually to accompany a written text.

data.name: Marc_ins_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who has written a statement of dedication or gift.

data.name: Marc_itr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who principally plays an instrument in a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_ive_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is interviewed at a consultation or meeting, usually by a reporter, pollster, or some other information gathering agent.

data.name: Marc_ivr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who acts as a reporter, pollster, or other information gathering agent in a consultation or meeting involving one or more individuals.

data.name: Marc_inv_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who first produces a particular useful item, or develops a new process for obtaining a known item or result.

data.name: Marc_isb_Desc
data.value: A person, family or organization issuing a work, such as an official organ of the body.

data.name: Marc_jud_Desc
data.value: A person who hears and decides on legal matters in court.

data.name: Marc_jug_Desc
data.value: A jurisdiction governed by a law, regulation, etc., that was enacted by another jurisdiction.

data.name: Marc_lbr_Desc
data.value: Use for an institution that provides scientific analyses of material samples.

data.name: Marc_ldr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that manages or supervises work done in a controlled setting or environment.

data.name: Marc_lsa_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization whose work involves coordinating the arrangement of existing and proposed land features and structures.

data.name: Marc_led_Desc
data.value: Use to indicate that a person or organization takes primary responsibility for a particular activity or endeavor. Use with another relator term or code to show the greater importance this person or organization has regarding that particular role. If more than one relator is assigned to a heading, use the Lead relator only if it applies to all the relators.

data.name: Marc_len_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization permitting the temporary use of a book, manuscript, etc., such as for photocopying or microfilming.

data.name: Marc_lil_Desc
data.value: Use for the party who files a libel in an ecclesiastical or admiralty case.

data.name: Marc_lit_Desc
data.value: Use for a libelant who takes an appeal from one ecclesiastical court or admiralty to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_lie_Desc
data.value: Use for a libelant against whom an appeal is taken from one ecclesiastical court or admiralty to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_lel_Desc
data.value: Use for a party against whom a libel has been filed in an ecclesiastical court or admiralty.

data.name: Marc_let_Desc
data.value: Use for a libelee who takes an appeal from one ecclesiastical court or admiralty to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_lee_Desc
data.value: Use for a libelee against whom an appeal is taken from one ecclesiastical court or admiralty to another to reverse the judgment.

data.name: Marc_lbt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is a writer of the text of an opera, oratorio, etc.

data.name: Marc_lse_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is an original recipient of the right to print or publish.

data.name: Marc_lso_Desc
data.value: Use for person or organization who is a signer of the license, imprimatur, etc.

data.name: Marc_lgd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who designs the lighting scheme for a theatrical presentation, entertainment, motion picture, etc.

data.name: Marc_ltg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who prepares the stone or plate for lithographic printing, including a graphic artist creating a design directly on the surface from which printing will be done.

data.name: Marc_lyr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is the a writer of the text of a song.

data.name: Marc_mfp_Desc
data.value: The place of manufacture (e.g., printing, duplicating, casting, etc.) of a resource in a published form.

data.name: Marc_mfr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that makes an artifactual work (an object made or modified by one or more persons). Examples of artifactual works include vases, cannons or pieces of furniture.

data.name: Marc_mrb_Desc
data.value: The entity responsible for marbling paper, cloth, leather, etc. used in construction of a resource.

data.name: Marc_mrk_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization performing the coding of SGML, HTML, or XML markup of metadata, text, etc.

data.name: Marc_med_Desc
data.value: A person held to be a channel of communication between the earthly world and a different world.

data.name: Marc_mdc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization primarily responsible for compiling and maintaining the original description of a metadata set (e.g., geospatial metadata set).

data.name: Marc_mte_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for decorations, illustrations, letters, etc. cut on a metal surface for printing or decoration.

data.name: Marc_mtk_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization responsible for recording the minutes of a meeting.

data.name: Marc_mod_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who leads a program (often broadcast) where topics are discussed, usually with participation of experts in fields related to the discussion.

data.name: Marc_mon_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that supervises compliance with the contract and is responsible for the report and controls its distribution. Sometimes referred to as the grantee, or controlling agency.

data.name: Marc_mcp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who transcribes or copies musical notation

data.name: Marc_msd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person responsible for basic music decisions about a production, including coordinating the work of the composer, the sound editor, and sound mixers, selecting musicians, and organizing and/or conducting sound for rehearsals and performances.

data.name: Marc_mus_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who performs music or contributes to the musical content of a work when it is not possible or desirable to identify the function more precisely.

data.name: Marc_nrt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who is a speaker relating the particulars of an act, occurrence, or course of events.

data.name: Marc_osp_Desc
data.value: A performer contributing to an expression of a work by appearing on screen in nonfiction moving image materials or introductions to fiction moving image materials to provide contextual or background information. Use when another term (e.g., Narrator, Host) is either not applicable or not desired.

data.name: Marc_opn_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for opposing a thesis or dissertation.

data.name: Marc_orm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for organizing a meeting for which an item is the report or proceedings.

data.name: Marc_org_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization performing the work, i.e., the name of a person or organization associated with the intellectual content of the work. This category does not include the publisher or personal affiliation, or sponsor except where it is also the corporate author.

data.name: Marc_oth_Desc
data.value: Use for relator codes from other lists which have no equivalent in the MARC list or for terms which have not been assigned a code.

data.name: Marc_own_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that currently owns an item or collection.

data.name: Marc_pan_Desc
data.value: performer contributing to a resource by participating in a program (often broadcast) where topics are discussed, usually with participation of experts in fields related to the discussion.

data.name: Marc_ppm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the production of paper, usually from wood, cloth, or other fibrous material.

data.name: Marc_pta_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that applied for a patent.

data.name: Marc_pth_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that was granted the patent referred to by the item.

data.name: Marc_pat_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for commissioning a work. Usually a patron uses his or her means or influence to support the work of artists, writers, etc. This includes those who commission and pay for individual works.

data.name: Marc_prf_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who exhibits musical or acting skills in a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment, if specific codes for those functions ([act], [dnc], [itr], [voc], etc.) are not used. If specific codes are used, [prf] is used for a person whose principal skill is not known or specified.

data.name: Marc_pma_Desc
data.value: Use for an authority (usually a government agency) that issues permits under which work is accomplished.

data.name: Marc_pht_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for taking photographs, whether they are used in their original form or as reproductions.

data.name: Marc_ptf_Desc
data.value: Use for the party who complains or sues in court in a personal action, usually in a legal proceeding.

data.name: Marc_ptt_Desc
data.value: Use for a plaintiff who takes an appeal from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in a legal proceeding.

data.name: Marc_pte_Desc
data.value: Use for a plaintiff against whom an appeal is taken from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in a legal proceeding.

data.name: Marc_plt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the production of plates, usually for the production of printed images and/or text.

data.name: Marc_pra_Desc
data.value: A person who is the faculty moderator of an academic disputation, normally proposing a thesis and participating in the ensuing disputation.

data.name: Marc_pre_Desc
data.value: A person or organization mentioned in an 'X presents' credit for moving image materials and who is associated with production, finance, or distribution in some way. A vanity credit; in early years, normally the head of a studio.

data.name: Marc_prt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who prints texts, whether from type or plates.

data.name: Marc_pop_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who prints illustrations from plates.

data.name: Marc_prm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who makes a relief, intaglio, or planographic printing surface.

data.name: Marc_prc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization primarily responsible for performing or initiating a process, such as is done with the collection of metadata sets.

data.name: Marc_pro_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the making of a motion picture, including business aspects, management of the productions, and the commercial success of the work.

data.name: Marc_prn_Desc
data.value: An organization that is responsible for financial, technical, and organizational management of a production for stage, screen, audio recording, television, webcast, etc.

data.name: Marc_prs_Desc
data.value: A person or organization responsible for designing the overall visual appearance of a moving image production.

data.name: Marc_pmn_Desc
data.value: Use for a person responsible for all technical and business matters in a production.

data.name: Marc_prd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization associated with the production (props, lighting, special effects, etc.) of a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_prp_Desc
data.value: The place of production (e.g., inscription, fabrication, construction, etc.) of a resource in an unpublished form.

data.name: Marc_prg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the creation and/or maintenance of computer program design documents, source code, and machine-executable digital files and supporting documentation.

data.name: Marc_pdr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization with primary responsibility for all essential aspects of a project, or that manages a very large project that demands senior level responsibility, or that has overall responsibility for managing projects, or provides overall direction to a project manager.

data.name: Marc_pfr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who corrects printed matter. For manuscripts, use Corrector [crr].

data.name: Marc_prv_Desc
data.value: A person or organization who produces, publishes, manufactures, or distributes a resource if specific codes are not desired (e.g. [mfr], [pbl].)

data.name: Marc_pup_Desc
data.value: The place where a resource is published.

data.name: Marc_pbl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that makes printed matter, often text, but also printed music, artwork, etc. available to the public.

data.name: Marc_pbd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who presides over the elaboration of a collective work to ensure its coherence or continuity. This includes editors-in-chief, literary editors, editors of series, etc.

data.name: Marc_ppt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who manipulates, controls, or directs puppets or marionettes in a musical or dramatic presentation or entertainment.

data.name: Marc_rdd_Desc
data.value: A director responsible for the general management and supervision of a radio program.

data.name: Marc_rpc_Desc
data.value: A producer responsible for most of the business aspects of a radio program.

data.name: Marc_rcp_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization to whom correspondence is addressed.

data.name: Marc_rce_Desc
data.value: A person contributing to a resource by supervising the technical aspects of a sound or video recording session.

data.name: Marc_red_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who writes or develops the framework for an item without being intellectually responsible for its content.

data.name: Marc_ren_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who prepares drawings of architectural designs (i.e., renderings) in accurate, representational perspective to show what the project will look like when completed.

data.name: Marc_rpt_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who writes or presents reports of news or current events on air or in print.

data.name: Marc_rps_Desc
data.value: Use for an agency that hosts data or material culture objects and provides services to promote long term, consistent and shared use of those data or objects.

data.name: Marc_rth_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who directed or managed a research project.

data.name: Marc_rtm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who participated in a research project but whose role did not involve direction or management of it.

data.name: Marc_res_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for performing research.

data.name: Marc_rsp_Desc
data.value: Use for the party who makes an answer to the courts pursuant to an application for redress, usually in an equity proceeding.

data.name: Marc_rst_Desc
data.value: Use for a respondent who takes an appeal from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in an equity proceeding.

data.name: Marc_rse_Desc
data.value: Use for a respondent against whom an appeal is taken from one court or jurisdiction to another to reverse the judgment, usually in an equity proceeding.

data.name: Marc_rpy_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization legally responsible for the content of the published material.

data.name: Marc_rsg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization, other than the original choreographer or director, responsible for restaging a choreographic or dramatic work and who contributes minimal new content.

data.name: Marc_rsr_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization responsible for the set of technical, editorial, and intellectual procedures aimed at compensating for the degradation of an item by bringing it back to a state as close as possible to its original condition.

data.name: Marc_rev_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for the review of a book, motion picture, performance, etc.

data.name: Marc_rbr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization responsible for parts of a work, often headings or opening parts of a manuscript, that appear in a distinctive color, usually red.

data.name: Marc_sce_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is the author of a motion picture screenplay.

data.name: Marc_sad_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who brings scientific, pedagogical, or historical competence to the conception and realization on a work, particularly in the case of audio-visual items.

data.name: Marc_scr_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who is an amanuensis and for a writer of manuscripts proper. For a person who makes pen-facsimiles, use Facsimilist [fac].

data.name: Marc_scl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who models or carves figures that are three-dimensional representations.

data.name: Marc_spy_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is identified as the party of the second part. In the case of transfer of right, this is the assignee, transferee, licensee, grantee, etc. Multiple parties can be named jointly as the second party.

data.name: Marc_sec_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who is a recorder, redactor, or other person responsible for expressing the views of a organization.

data.name: Marc_sll_Desc
data.value: A former owner of an item who sold that item to another owner.

data.name: Marc_std_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who translates the rough sketches of the art director into actual architectural structures for a theatrical presentation, entertainment, motion picture, etc. Set designers draw the detailed guides and specifications for building the set.

data.name: Marc_stg_Desc
data.value: An entity in which the activity or plot of a work takes place, e.g. a geographic place, a time period, a building, an event.

data.name: Marc_sgn_Desc
data.value: Use for a person whose signature appears without a presentation or other statement indicative of provenance. When there is a presentation statement, use Inscriber [ins].

data.name: Marc_sng_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who uses his/her/their voice with or without instrumental accompaniment to produce music. A performance may or may not include actual words.

data.name: Marc_sds_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who produces and reproduces the sound score (both live and recorded), the installation of microphones, the setting of sound levels, and the coordination of sources of sound for a production.

data.name: Marc_spk_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who participates in a program (often broadcast) and makes a formalized contribution or presentation generally prepared in advance.

data.name: Marc_spn_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that issued a contract or under the auspices of which a work has been written, printed, published, etc.

data.name: Marc_sgd_Desc
data.value: A person or organization contributing to a stage resource through the overall management and supervision of a performance.

data.name: Marc_stm_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who is in charge of everything that occurs on a performance stage, and who acts as chief of all crews and assistant to a director during rehearsals.

data.name: Marc_stn_Desc
data.value: Use for an organization responsible for the development or enforcement of a standard.

data.name: Marc_str_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who creates a new plate for printing by molding or copying another printing surface.

data.name: Marc_stl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person relaying a story with creative and/or theatrical interpretation.

data.name: Marc_sht_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization that supports (by allocating facilities, staff, or other resources) a project, program, meeting, event, data objects, material culture objects, or other entities capable of support.

data.name: Marc_srv_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who does measurements of tracts of land, etc. to determine location, forms, and boundaries.

data.name: Marc_tch_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who, in the context of a resource, gives instruction in an intellectual subject or demonstrates while teaching physical skills.

data.name: Marc_tcd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who is ultimately in charge of scenery, props, lights and sound for a production.

data.name: Marc_tld_Desc
data.value: A director responsible for the general management and supervision of a television program.

data.name: Marc_tlp_Desc
data.value: A producer responsible for most of the business aspects of a television program.

data.name: Marc_ths_Desc
data.value: Use for a person under whose supervision a degree candidate develops and presents a thesis, mémoire, or text of a dissertation.

data.name: Marc_trc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who prepares a handwritten or typewritten copy from original material, including from dictated or orally recorded material. For makers of pen-facsimiles, use Facsimilist [fac].

data.name: Marc_trl_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who renders a text from one language into another, or from an older form of a language into the modern form.

data.name: Marc_tyd_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who designed the type face used in a particular item.

data.name: Marc_tyg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization primarily responsible for choice and arrangement of type used in an item. If the typographer is also responsible for other aspects of the graphic design of a book (e.g., Book designer [bkd]), codes for both functions may be needed.

data.name: Marc_uvp_Desc
data.value: A place where a university that is associated with a resource is located, for example, a university where an academic dissertation or thesis was presented.

data.name: Marc_vdg_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization in charge of a video production, e.g. the video recording of a stage production as opposed to a commercial motion picture. The videographer may be the camera operator or may supervise one or more camera operators. Do not confuse with cinematographer.

data.name: Marc_vac_Desc
data.value: An actor contributing to a resource by providing the voice for characters in radio and audio productions and for animated characters in moving image works, as well as by providing voice overs in radio and television commercials, dubbed resources, etc.

data.name: Marc_wit_Desc
data.value: Use for a person who verifies the truthfulness of an event or action.

data.name: Marc_wde_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who makes prints by cutting the image in relief on the end-grain of a wood block.

data.name: Marc_wdc_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who makes prints by cutting the image in relief on the plank side of a wood block.

data.name: Marc_wam_Desc
data.value: Use for a person or organization who writes significant material which accompanies a sound recording or other audiovisual material.

data.name: Marc_wac_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to an expression of a work by providing an interpretation or critical explanation of the original work.

data.name: Marc_wal_Desc
data.value: A writer of words added to an expression of a musical work. For lyric writing in collaboration with a composer to form an original work, see lyricist.

data.name: Marc_wat_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a non-textual resource by providing text for the non-textual work (e.g., writing captions for photographs, descriptions of maps.)

data.name: Marc_win_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a resource by providing an introduction to the original work.

data.name: Marc_wpr_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a resource by providing a preface to the original work.

data.name: Marc_wst_Desc
data.value: A person, family, or organization contributing to a resource by providing supplementary textual content (e.g., an introduction, a preface) to the original work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-abstract_Desc
data.value: A short summary of the principle ideas, concepts and conclusions of the work, or of section or excerpt within it.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-acknowledgments_Desc
data.value: A section or statement that acknowledges significant contributions by persons, organizations, governments, and other entities to the realization of the work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-afterword_Desc
data.value: A closing statement from the author or a person of importance, typically providing insight into how the content came to be written, its significance or related events that have transpired since its timeline.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-appendix_Desc
data.value: A section of supplemental information located after the primary content that informs the content but is not central to it.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-backlink_Desc
data.value: A link that allows the user to return to a related location in the content (e.g., from a footnote to its references or from a glossary definition to where a term is used.)

data.name: AriaRole_doc-bibliography_Desc
data.value: A list of external references cited in the work, which may be to print or digital sources.

data.name: AriaRole_biblioentry_Desc
data.value: A single reference to an external source in a bibliography. [epub:type ONLY]

data.name: AriaRole_doc-biblioref_Desc
data.value: A reference to a bibliography entry.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-chapter_Desc
data.value: A major thematic section of content in a work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-colophon_Desc
data.value: A short section of production notes particular to the edition (e.g., describing the typeface used), often located at the end of a work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-conclusion_Desc
data.value: A concluding section or statement that summarizes the work or wraps up the narrative.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-cover_Desc
data.value: An image that sets the mood or tone for the work and typically includes the title and author.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-credit_Desc
data.value: An acknowledgement of the source of integrated content from third-party sources, such as photos. Typically identifies the creator, copyright, and any restrictions on reuse.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-dedication_Desc
data.value: An inscription at the front of the work, typically addressed in tribute to one or more persons close to the author.

data.name: AriaRole_endnote_Desc
data.value: One of a collection of notes that occur at the end of a work, or a section within it that provides additional context to a referenced passage of text. [epub:type ONLY]

data.name: AriaRole_doc-endnotes_Desc
data.value: A collection of notes at the end of a work or a section within it.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-epigraph_Desc
data.value: A quotation set at the start of the work or a section that establishes the theme or sets the mood.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-epilogue_Desc
data.value: A concluding section of narrative that wraps up or comments on the actions and events of the work, typically from a future perspective.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-errata_Desc
data.value: A set of corrections discovered after initial publication of the work, sometimes referred to as corrigenda.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-example_Desc
data.value: An illustration of a key concept of the work, such as a code listing, case study or problem. [aria role ONLY]

data.name: AriaRole_doc-footnote_Desc
data.value: Ancillary information, such as a citation or commentary, that provides additional context to a referenced passage of text.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-foreword_Desc
data.value: An introductory section that precedes the work, typically not written by the author of the work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-glossary_Desc
data.value: A brief dictionary of new, uncommon, or specialized terms used in the content.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-glossref_Desc
data.value: A reference to a glossary definition.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-index_Desc
data.value: A navigational aid that provides a detailed list of links to key subjects, names and other important topics covered in the work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-introduction_Desc
data.value: A preliminary section that typically introduces the scope or nature of the work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-noteref_Desc
data.value: A reference to a footnote or endnote, typically appearing as a superscripted number or symbol in the main body of the text.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-notice_Desc
data.value: Notifies the user of consequences that might arise from an action or event. Examples include warnings, cautions and dangers.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-pagebreak_Desc
data.value: A separator denoting the position before which a break occurs between contiguous pages in a statically paginated version of the content.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-pagefooter_Desc
data.value: A section of text appearing at the bottom of a page that provides context about the current work and location within it. The page footer is distinct from the body text and normally follows a repeating template that contains (possibly truncated) items such as the document title, current section, author name(s), and page number.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-pageheader_Desc
data.value: A section of text appearing at the top of a page that provides context about the current work and location within it. The page header is distinct from the body text and normally follows a repeating template that contains (possibly truncated) items such as the document title, current section, author name(s), and page number.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-pagelist_Desc
data.value: A navigational aid that provides a list of links to the page breaks in the content.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-part_Desc
data.value: A major structural division in a work that contains a set of related sections dealing with a particular subject, narrative arc, or similar encapsulated theme.

data.name: AriaRole_preamble_Desc
data.value: A section at the beginning of a work, typically containing introductory and/or explanatory prose regarding the scope or nature of the work's content. [epub:type ONLY]

data.name: AriaRole_doc-preface_Desc
data.value: An introductory section that precedes the work, typically written by the author of the work.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-prologue_Desc
data.value: An introductory section that sets the background to a work, typically part of the narrative.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-pullquote_Desc
data.value: A distinctively placed or highlighted quotation from the current content designed to draw attention to a topic or highlight a key point.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-qna_Desc
data.value: A section of content structured as a series of questions and answers, such as an interview or list of frequently asked questions.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-subtitle_Desc
data.value: An explanatory or alternate title for the work, or a section or components within it.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-tip_Desc
data.value: Helpful information that clarifies some aspect of the content or assists in comprehension.

data.name: AriaRole_doc-toc_Desc
data.value: A navigational aid that provides an ordered list of links to the major sectional headings in the content. A table of contents may cover an entire work, or only a smaller section of it.

data.name: SpecialChar_U+0192_Desc
data.value: Latin small letter f with hook
